articles.title: Jordan Firstman Made Club Kid as ‘An Act of Compassion for Myself’
articles.summary: For Jordan Firstman, tears shed during the making of Club Kid would turn out to be a harbinger of success. “I remember getting to the end of the edit, and I would cry every time watching it,” he recalls over Zoom. “My editor would cry every time. Everyone who was allowed in the edit was crying. And so I knew people were gonna be moved.” What the actor, writer, and internet personality did not predict for his feature debut was just how big and immediate that impact would be. articles.title: Why BMI Is Not the Best Measure of Health
articles.summary: BMI, or body mass index, has long been a part of health evaluations. A calculation that takes into account a person’s weight and height, BMI is supposed to reflect how much excess fat a person might be carrying and give doctors a sense of a patient's risk for obesity-related health conditions. For years, however, doctors have found that BMI isn’t the best measure of obesity-related health, since it can’t distinguish between fat and muscle weight.
